subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Greenwashing Dangers
description: Learn Greenwashing Dangers in one minute.

hook.text: A brand labels its product 'eco-friendly' with zero evidence. A lawsuit and social media storm follow.

buildup.text: Greenwashing is making misleading claims about environmental benefits to appear more sustainable.

discovery.text: It erodes consumer trust, invites regulatory fines, and damages brand reputation when exposed.

twist.text: Even well-intentioned companies greenwash accidentally by overstating partial improvements.

climax.text: The EU Green Claims Directive will require proof for every environmental claim. Vague labels won't survive.

punchline.text: If you can't prove it's green, don't claim it is.
